BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC has announced the repurchase of 499,999 ordinary shares on June 1, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of 1448.2312 pence, and a further 12,246 shares on June 3, 2026, at an average price of 1424.5716 pence, as part of its $250 million share buyback program. These repurchases, conducted through J.P. Morgan Securities plc, are intended to be cancelled, and following these transactions, Hikma will have 213,794,638 ordinary shares in issue.
